To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimal DNA/RNA extraction protocols are dependent upon the downstream HTS application.

1) the DNA extraction method from FFPE samples is not critical for the success of downstream sequencing, 2) RNA extraction from FFPE samples using the Covaris kit or the Beckman Coulter kit is recommended for the detection of recurrent fusion transcripts in sarcomas.
DNA and RNA extraction protocols from archival formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) samples can be optimized to improve the quality and yield of nucleic acids.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying the most suitable DNA and RNA extraction method for FFPE samples.
the evaluation of commercial DNA and/or RNA extraction methods for HTS of FFPE samples.
the development of a method to isolate nucleic acid of sufficient quality and quantity for HTS from archival FFPE specimens.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
all kits tested are suitable for FFPE samples and that the best kit is the one that works best for the particular application.
there is no one best extraction kit, but the Covaris truXTRAc FFPE DNA kit and RNA kit are the most promising.
the Covaris truXTRACT kits (DNA and/or RNA) are the best choice for FFPE samples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
truXTRACT DNA and RNA extraction kits from Covaris gave the best results in our study.
the Covaris truXTRAX FFPE DNA/RNA extraction kit gave the best performance in both DNA and RNA extraction.
for DNA extraction, the Covaris truXTRAX FFPE DNA kit is the best choice, while for RNA extraction the Covaris truxXTRAC FFEP RNA kit and the Beckman Coulter FormaPure kit are the best choices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no universal protocol for FFPE nucleid acid extraction, and that the optimal extraction method depends on the downstream applications.
the truXTRA kits are optimal for both RNA and DNA extraction from FFPE tissue.
for FFPE nucleotide material, it is important to use an appropriate extraction protocol, and that the extraction protocol should be optimized for the downstream assay.
